2607.08758.title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
2607.08758.paper_summary: Scientific ideas rarely start from a blank page. They inherit mechanisms, repair known limitations, and recombine pieces of earlier work, much like biological genomes. Current benchmarks still say little about whether AI systems can follow this inheritance structure. We present IdeaGene-Bench (IG-Bench), a benchmark for scientific lineage reasoning and lineage-grounded idea generation. IG-Bench is organized around the IdeaGene framework: each paper or proposal is represented as a set of minimal, typed, evidence-grounded Idea Genome objects, and a GenomeDiff aligns these objects to record inheritance, mutation, loss, external import, and novel insertion under six operational evolutionary dynamics. The benchmark contains 1,961 golden lineage traces, 1,085 curated Idea Genome objects, and 920 pairwise GenomeDiff records across 10 scientific domains. It supports two evaluations. IG-Exam (42 task types, 1,029 instances) tests closed-form lineage reasoning across Idea Genome abstraction, inheritance tracing, evolutionary reasoning, and lineage verification. IG-Arena evaluates generation with a lineage-conditioned Population-Evolution Score(PES), asking whether a proposal can be inserted as a coherent descendant of a given lineage population: it should inherit the right Idea Genome objects, vary meaningfully from nearby work, and offer selection value for future research. Experiments on 14 LLM-based scientists expose a compositional bottleneck. The strongest system reaches only 27.3% exact accuracy on lineage reasoning, and structured lineage context reshuffles system rankings rather than helping every participant uniformly.
2607.08758.paper_summary_zh: 科學思想很少從一張白紙開始。它們繼承機制、修補已知的限制，並重新組合早期工作的片段，就像生物基因組一樣。當前的基準仍然對AI系統是否能遵循這種繼承結構說得不多。我們提出了IdeaGene-Bench（IG-Bench），這是一個用於科學血統推理和基於血統的創意生成的基準。IG-Bench圍繞IdeaGene框架組織：每篇論文或提案被表示為一組最小的、類型化的、基於證據的Idea Genome對象，而GenomeDiff則對齊這些對象以記錄繼承、突變、損失、外部引入和在六種操作性進化動態下的新插入。該基準包含1,961條黃金血統痕跡、1,085個經過策劃的Idea Genome對象，以及跨越10個科學領域的920對GenomeDiff記錄。它支持兩種評估。IG-Exam（42種任務類型，1,029個實例）測試在Idea Genome抽象、繼承追蹤、進化推理和血統驗證中的封閉形式血統推理。IG-Arena評估使用基於血統的群體進化分數（PES）進行生成，詢問一個提案是否可以作為給定血統群體的連貫後代插入：它應該繼承正確的Idea Genome對象，與附近的工作有意義的變化，並為未來的研究提供選擇價值。對14個基於LLM的科學家的實驗揭示了一個組合瓶頸。最強的系統在血統推理上僅達到27.3%的精確準確率，結構化的血統上下文重新排列系統排名，而不是幫助每個參與者均勻受益。
